title: Odoo forces its restrictive audit trail on for German companies and blocks disabling it
content:
`addons/l10n_de/models/res_company.py` contains `company.force_restrictive_audit_trail |= company.country_code == 'DE'`, and `addons/account/models/company.py` enforces it: attempting to disable raises *"Can't disable restricted audit trail: forced by localization."*

The German fiscal documentation states that *"Odoo is certified GoBD-compliant"* and that with the German localization *"Odoo is in standard configured in such a way that the inalterability clause can be adhered to without any further customization."* A SHA-256 hash chain over eight accounting fields backs it, each entry incorporating the previous entry's hash.

For a German buyer this makes Odoo the statutory books rather than a candidate for replacement. An external record layer should not attempt to be a parallel ledger here; the honest role is integration.
description: l10n_de sets force_restrictive_audit_trail for country code DE, and a constraint raises an error if anyone tries to switch it off, in service of GoBD compliance.
